How we know

Ike's Basement Bike Shop's event page says 'Critical Mass - PGH, 2nd Friday of every month (rain or shine!)' and lists Jan 9 through May 8, 2026 at 6:30 pm from Friendship Park (read Oct 2, 2026). The page does not list dates after May.

For visitors

The shop's listing says rain or shine. Ike's Basement Bike Shop posts the dates on its calendar. Confirm the start before a first ride; the page lists a 6:30 pm start and a 10:00 pm end.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Slow, steady and raucous. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Critical Mass Pittsburgh group ride

Critical Mass Pittsburgh is a Critical Mass ride in Pittsburgh, PA. It rolls second Friday of the month at 6:30 pm from Friendship Park.

A monthly group ride through Pittsburgh on the second Friday. The shop that lists it calls it slow, steady and raucous, with community and joy as resistance. The calendar entries run from 6:30 pm at Friendship Park.
